function draw<T>(arb: fc.Arbitrary<T>): T {

}
/** Draw an input the declared Zod schema accepts (the static arbitrary is a heuristic; the schema is the truth). */
function drawInput(h: AverriTestHarness, owner: string, arb: fc.Arbitrary<unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
  for (const candidate of fc.sample(arb, 50)) {
    if (h.parseInput(owner, candidate).ok) return candidate as Record<string, unknown>;
  }
  // The static arbitrary missed a schema constraint: keep what it drew where the schema agrees, re-sample the rest from the schema.
  for (const candidate of fc.sample(arb, 10)) {
    const conformed = h.conformInput(owner, candidate);
    if (conformed !== null) return conformed;
  }
  throw new Error(`no input passing the Zod schema of ${owner} could be drawn; the schema needs a constraint averri cannot sample (a refinement or transform)`);
}

async function ensureRow(m: PrismaModelLike, where: Record<string, unknown>, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  return (await m.findFirst({ where })) ?? (await m.create({ data }));
}
/** The row identified by the unique `key` with `pins` applied: updated in place when it exists, created otherwise. */
async function ensurePinned(m: PrismaModelLike, key: Record<string, unknown>, pins: Record<string, unknown>, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  const existing = await m.findFirst({ where: key });
  if (existing === null) return m.create({ data });
  await m.updateMany({ where: key, data: pins });
  return (await m.findFirst({ where: key })) ?? existing;
}

}
function get(value: unknown, path: string[]): unknown {
  let cur: unknown = value;
  for (const seg of path) {
    if (cur === null || typeof cur !== "object") return undefined;
    cur = (cur as Record<string, unknown>)[seg];
  }
  return cur;
}
function altered(v: unknown): unknown {
  if (typeof v === "string") return `${v}_x`;
  if (typeof v === "number") return v + 1;
  if (typeof v === "bigint") return v + 1n;
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return !v;
  if (v instanceof Date) return new Date(v.getTime() + 86_400_000);
  return "altered";
}
function bump(v: unknown, delta: number): unknown {
  if (typeof v === "number") return v + delta;
  if (typeof v === "bigint") return v + BigInt(delta);
  if (v instanceof Date) return new Date(v.getTime() + delta * 86_400_000);
  if (typeof v === "string" && !Number.isNaN(Date.parse(v))) return new Date(Date.parse(v) + delta * 86_400_000);
  throw new Error(`cannot offset ${String(v)} by ${delta}`);
}
function is2xx(status: number): boolean {
  return status >= 200 && status < 300;
}
function errorBody(res: Invoked): { error?: string; contract?: string } {
  return typeof res.body === "object" && res.body !== null ? (res.body as { error?: string; contract?: string }) : {};
}
function phaseRecord(trace: TraceLike | null, phase: string, contract: string): PhaseLike | undefined {
  return trace?.phases.find((p) => p.phase === phase && p.contract === contract);
}
function emittedCount(trace: TraceLike | null, event: string): number {
  const emit = trace?.phases.find((p) => p.phase === "emit");
  return (emit?.events ?? []).filter((e) => e.event === event).length;
}
function expect2xx(res: Invoked, what: string): void {

}

  for (const fixture of FIXTURES) {
    if (fixture === "anonymous") continue;
    const env: Env = { input, actor: h.actor(fixture) };
    void env;
    const decision = await h.policyDecision("Action:Team.rename", fixture, input);
    if (decision === "allow" || decision === "public" || decision === "opaque") return fixture;
  }
  throw new Error("no actor fixture in FIXTURES is allowed by Policy:Team.AdminOnly for this input; add a fixture to config.actors or seed the rows the policy needs");
}

async function invokeAllowed_Team_rename(h: AverriTestHarness, input: Record<string, unknown>, options?: { headers?: Record<string, string> }): Promise<{ res: Invoked; fixture: string; env: Env }> {

  await seedRequires_Team_rename(h, env);

describe("[Test:gen/Team.rename.auth-matrix]", () => {
  // Observe mode: the app's own 401/403 vs 2xx is compared with the declared policy evaluated against each fixture's actor.
  function expectAuth(res: Invoked, expected: string): void {
    // 404 counts as a denial: apps commonly answer "not found" for resources outside the actor's reach (D-40)
    if (expected === "unauthenticated" || expected === "deny") { expect([401, 403, 404], `denied actor: got ${res.status}`).toContain(res.status); return; }
    expect2xx(res, "allowed actor");
  }
  for (const fixture of FIXTURES) {
    it(`[Test:gen/Team.rename.auth-matrix] [Policy:Team.AdminOnly] ${fixture}: app decision matches the declared policy`, async () => {
      const input = drawInput(h, "Action:Team.rename", input_valid_Team_rename);
      const env: Env = { input, actor: h.actor(fixture) };
      const expected = await h.policyDecision("Action:Team.rename", fixture, input);
      if (expected === "allow" || expected === "public" || expected === "opaque") { await seedRequires_Team_rename(h, env); await seedSubject_Team_rename(h, env); }
      const res = await h.invoke("Action:Team.rename", fixture, input);
      expectAuth(res, expected);
    });
  }
});

  // Observe mode: a violation is a non-2xx response whose trace has `ok: false` for the contract; satisfying input is 2xx.
  it("[Test:gen/Team.rename.precondition] [Contract:Team.rename.requires.seatsPositive] violation is rejected", async () => {
